name: 2.9.15 - Invoice read (dry run)
notes: Invoice read (dry run): a new Invoice tab reads the COSTAR Invoice that is already open: its number, order, status and branch; every X field and every Ship to (Y) field, kept apart with COSTAR's own labels (or a plain description where COSTAR's box has none); every line with its exact Item/SKU (on invoices over 25 lines it scrolls the line list and back, nothing else is pressed); freight (Item F) shown on its own as an amount, zero, no entry or unreadable; totals checked against the lines. Copy Buffalo Details copies a labelled summary in which every rule not yet decided (sender, X or Y, references, weights, service) is UNRESOLVED; it always says NOT READY FOR BOOKING. Nothing is sold, saved, booked, printed or sent; Sold is a disabled button. Not yet checked on a live COSTAR. Update the RDP helper (and the desk PC, to keep them the same).
